question: Suppose $f:\mathbb Z\to\mathbb Z$ is a non-decreasing function. Consider the following two cases: Case 1: $f(0)=2, f(10)=8$. Case 2: $f(0)=-2, f(10)=12$. In which of the above cases is it necessarily true that there exists an $n$ with $f(n)=n$?

options.C: In Case 1, but not necessarily in Case 2.
options.D: In Case 2, but not necessarily in Case 1.
